decisions.reason: The management platform is the publicly announced flagship of the agency-focused direction and carries heavy prior investment, so management would treat any weak results as temporary and keep backing it.

The configurable managed plan sits close to the core hosting business, is cheap to run on the owned container infrastructure, and supports the scalability promise, so there is little reason to withdraw it.

Extended PHP security support fits the firm's announced security and compliance focus and is cheap to sustain, though its low website visibility and the time-limited nature of legacy-version support make a later withdrawal somewhat more plausible.
